title: B2B Video Marketing: A Full-Funnel Campaign System
summary: Build a B2B video marketing system across paid ads, product demos, launches, landing pages, sales, customer proof, and content repurposing.
body_markdown:
B2B video marketing uses video to create demand, explain a product, prove a workflow, support evaluation, enable sales, and help customers succeed. Build around buyer questions and reusable product evidence. One approved source can become paid ads, a product demo, launch clips, landing-page video, sales snippets, and customer education.


## Map video to the buyer’s question


Buyer question Useful video


Why should this problem matter? Short commercial or insight-led ad


What does the product do? Explainer or overview


How does it work? Product demo


Will it fit our workflow? Role use case or integration video


Can we trust it? Authorized customer story or technical proof


What changed? Feature or product-launch video


## Build from reusable evidence


Maintain approved positioning, product facts, current UI, demonstrations, diagrams, customer proof, brand assets, and claims. This source library reduces contradiction across campaigns and makes updates traceable.


## Paid video


Lead with one role, problem, or outcome. Demonstrate enough of the product to support the promise. Create different angles for different stakeholders rather than shrinking a broad corporate overview.


## Organic and launch video


Teach a useful workflow, explain a market shift, show a new capability, or break down a real build. The product should be the working tool inside the story, not an unrelated end-card.
